hints.title: Relate Cell to Maximal Square Bottom-Right Corner
hints.text: Let cell (r, c) store the side length of the largest square of all 1s ending at that cell.

hints.title: Check Three Preceding Neighbor Cells
hints.text: If matrix[r][c] is 1, dp[r][c] equals 1 plus minimum of top, left, and top-left neighbor values.

hints.title: Sum All Values in DP Matrix
hints.text: A square of size s ending at (r, c) contributes exactly s squares of sizes 1 through s; sum all dp values.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Verifying every potential square of side length 1..min(M, N) takes O(M * N * min(M, N)^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place 2D dynamic programming solves the total count in O(M * N) with O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that dp[r][c] directly counts how many squares end at (r, c).
complexity.notes: Can modify input matrix in place or use separate table.
